one_or_two_run_decision.visible_matching_archive_cache: One run can prove restored archive digest and fresh extraction if exact cache hit is observed; it cannot prove a new cold save or real Ghidra execution via this evaluator.
one_or_two_run_decision.cache_miss: Normally two sequential successful same-ref runs: first verified download plus post-job save, then exact restore hit plus checksum and extraction. Unchanged current ghidriff path cannot ensure first success/save.
one_or_two_run_decision.unknown_cache: Do not assume warm or cold. Inspect permitted cache metadata if later available or actual restore logs of an independently authorized run.
one_or_two_run_decision.scope: Cache includes key, internal version and branch; default-branch caches are available to other branches. Same-ref sequential runs avoid sibling-ref assumptions.

required_acceptance_receipts: Exact workflow source head and checkout SHA, dispatch inputs, plan digest and scope
Java/Ghidra setup unskipped; exact pinned GHIDRA_URL/digest and ghidra-archive/ghidra.zip: OK before extraction
Cold case: cache miss plus verified archive download and successful post save of exact key
Warm case: actual exact-key cache restore success plus repeated sha256sum OK before fresh extraction; a key string alone is insufficient
A separate actual native Ghidra/Ghidriff invocation and its exact authored input identity/result is needed for engine acceptance; installed package alone is not engine use
Record per-pair BLOCKED/failed results and shard exit status separately from aggregate warning/job outcome; retain all original logs/artifacts
